prose: Qualcomm used its Snapdragon Summit 2026 to announce that Linux support is coming to the Snapdragon X2 series - a notable opening for Windows-on-ARM hardware that has so far kept Linux users on workarounds. The cached coverage is thin (a summit roundup mentioning agentic AI PCs, 'Googlebooks' and Linux), so kernel-version and distribution details are unavailable; this summary is based on the headline and the cached stub.
highlights: Linux support announced for Snapdragon X2 series
Announced at Snapdragon Summit 2026 alongside agentic-AI PC pushes
Cached coverage thin; kernel and distro details unavailable
Drew 106 points and 53 comments on Hacker News
